name: Mediator
summary: Defines an object that encapsulates how a set of objects interact, keeping them from referring to each other explicitly.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Mediator
roles.summary: Declares the interface through which colleagues communicate.

roles.name: ConcreteMediator
roles.summary: Knows the colleagues and coordinates their interactions.

roles.name: Colleague
roles.summary: Communicates with the other participants only through the mediator.
